title: SDLC Evidence v1
description: A bounded evidence item that names its source, states the claim it supports, and records the evidence tier and source boundary.
$comment: Evidence records a bounded claim; it does not raise the strength of the referenced source. Host validation must resolve ref, verify source and tier against the actual evidence, and prevent evidence from being treated as approval or lifecycle mutation.

id.description: Stable evidence identifier within the result that records it.

kind.description: The semantic kind of the evidence source.

ref.description: Durable reference to the evidence source or record.

claim.description: The precise bounded claim supported by this evidence item.
examples: The focused regression test passed for the corrected behavior.

tier.description: The highest evidence tier actually established by the referenced source.

source.description: The boundary from which the evidence was obtained.

examples.claim: The focused regression test passed for the corrected behavior.
